notes.title: Update 2.0.0!
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing Harvest Moon: Light of Hope! We have just released version 2.0.0, which transforms the game into Harvest Moon: Light of Hope Special Edition!

This update will include not only minor bug fixes and enhancements to the Farming Friend function, but also adds a new marriageable candidate: Soleil! Soleil also functions as a local co-op character, where you and a friend can play Harvest Moon: Light of Hope Special Edition together! This update also means the four DLC available for the Special Edition on other platforms is available to purchase on Steam as well!

 
We hope everyone enjoys the game and we're always reading the Community Hub, so don't hesitate to leave feedback.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2!
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing Harvest Moon: Light of Hope! We have just released version 1.0.2 and here are the updates!
 
* Added Cloud Saving
 
* Shortcut Keys Added
Default Keys are
 M = Map (Once Received)
 N = Request Menu
Note : Key configuration is also available from the Options Menu.
 
* Zoom Reset Issue fixed.
 
* Quest Issue Fix 
 
* Miscellaneous Text Fixes
 
* Other Minor Fixes
 
We hope everyone enjoys the game and we're always reading the Community Hub, so don't hesitate to leave feedback!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1!
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing Harvest Moon: Light of Hope!
 
We have just released an updated version that fixes a few minor issues including the default key settings.
 
Here is the new default key assignments:
 
W = Up
A = Left
S = Down
D = Right
X = Action
C = Cancel
Space = Rucksack
Q = Tabs Left
E = Tabs Right
 
Note: This doesn’t change your key assignments if you have already manually changed them.
Note: Key configuration is also available from the Options Menu.
 
We hope everyone enjoys the game and we're always reading the Community Hub, so don't hesitate to leave feedback!
